page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre. Dedicatory heading and text block in the upper half, with a signature line set right-aligned at the end. Faint show-through from the reverse page below; no margin notes.
page.running_head: AD D. CHRIST. PALAT. ROD. GVAL. PRAEF.

main_text.p: Pridie Calend. Martias. Anno Incarnati Filij Dei M. D. LXXX. quando ante annos mille centum & octoginta Theodosius, Imperator piissimus & victoriosissimus, Deorum templa destruxit, & Bacchi Orgia similesq; alias superstitionis gentium reliquias aboleuit: memorabili prorsus exemplo, quod Christiani Principes imitentur.
main_text.head: Tuæ Clementiæ
obseruantissimus

page.notes: The printed date reads "M. D. LXXX." in the first line; the numeral is set as printed. The signature block is set to the right and the lines beside "Tuæ Clementiæ" and "obseruantissimus" are part of the dedication formula. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is present and was not transcribed.
